If the testbench asserts input_axis_tvalid=0 while output_axis_tready_int=1 the original code would advance the cycle counter and set input_axis_tready_next=output_axis_tready_int_early, causing a premature ready and the observed cycle-8 mismatch on input_axis_tready."}, {"id": "patch_cfc8ea21a9a5", "failure_port": "input_axis_tready", "source_line": 167, "mechanism": "At the top of STATE_IDLE the branch condition is just EXPAND_BUS; adding the input_axis_tvalid guard makes the branch taken only when a valid word arrives. Without it the FSM would enter the expand-bus path with input_axis_tvalid=0, schedule a transfer-out and assert input_axis_tready_next=1 at cycle 8 while the oracle expects 0."}, {"id": "patch_3cb99864f502", "failure_port": "output_axis_tlast", "source_line": 185, "mechanism": "The condition that qualifies input_axis_tlast with output_axis_tready_int makes tlast propagate only when the output side can accept data. In the trace cycle 8 the output is not ready, so tlast must stay de-asserted; the unguarded original lets tlast leak into output_axis_tlast_int causing the mismatch."}, {"id": "patch_ae44e878a6d3", "failure_port": "output_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 203, "mechanism": "In STATE_TRANSFER_OUT the branch that emits output_axis_tvalid_int is gated by input_axis_tlast. The failing cycle shows output_axis_tvalid=1 when the oracle expects 0; adding the tlast guard prevents the spurious valid when the frame has not actually ended."}, {"id": "patch_b689ecffefee", "failure_port": "output_axis_tlast", "source_line": 220, "mechanism": "Qualifying input_axis_tvalid with output_axis_tready_int couples the input handshake to the output back-pressure. When output is not ready the valid should not be sampled; the missing gate lets a stale valid propagate and corrupts output_axis_tlast at cycle 8."}, {"id": "patch_0517c5c2c927", "failure_port": "input_axis_tready", "source_line": 148, "mechanism": "Replacing the constant 0 default with input_axis_tready_reg preserves the previous ready state across cycles. The trace shows input_axis_tready toggling at cycle 8; a hard 0 default would force it low and break the handshake timing that the oracle expects."}, {"id": "patch_4da73638e1ac", "failure_port": "output_axis_tlast", "source_line": 250, "mechanism": "The transfer-out exit condition for the non-expand bus qualifies cycle-end with output_axis_tready_int. Without the gate the FSM would declare the frame finished and assert tlast even when the output is back-pressured, producing the cycle-8 output_axis_tlast mismatch."}, {"id": "patch_86feac8aac1d", "failure_port": "input_axis_tready", "source_line": 167, "mechanism": "Changing the STATE_IDLE expand-bus gate from EXPAND_BUS to EXPAND_BUS && input_axis_tlast makes the FSM wait for an explicit end-of-frame before entering the expand path. The trace cycle 8 has no tlast, so the original would incorrectly take the branch and assert ready."}], "explanation": "The three mismatches all occur at cycle 8/9 and involve handshake timing under back-pressure. input_axis_tready is asserted one cycle early because the FSM enters expand-bus or transfer-out states without checking that a valid input word and output readiness are both present. output_axis_tlast leaks because tlast is propagated without gating on output_axis_tready_int. output_axis_tvalid pulses high because the emit condition in STATE_TRANSFER_OUT lacks a tlast guard. The eight patches above each add the missing scalar qualification at the exact combinational site cited, aligning the FSM's cycle-exact behavior with the oracle trace."}
